files.README.md:
# Crankset Supplies - September order book

One row per order from the sales export. The export job retried twice after a
gateway timeout, so some orders were written more than once.
files.notes/courier-rounds.txt:
Brindle & Co takes the Thursday round.
Hartwell Bros prefers the Monday collection.

And Hartwell Bros? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
